title: Smoked Lamb Kebabs with German Spice
description: A flavorful German-inspired dish featuring juicy lamb kebabs with a smoky twist. Perfect for a summer evening or outdoor BBQ.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder or leg, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: You can also use lamb chops instead of cubes

ingredients.name: Smoked paprika
ingredients.notes: This gives the kebabs a smoky flavor

ingredients.name: Garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: Use fresh garlic for the best flavor

ingredients.name: German-style mustard
ingredients.notes: This adds a tangy flavor to the kebabs

ingredients.name: Salt and black pepper
ingredients.notes: Adjust the seasoning to your liking

ingredients.name: Vegetables (bell peppers, onions, mushrooms, cherry tomatoes)
ingredients.notes: Choose your favorite vegetables to grill with the lamb

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a good quality olive oil for grilling

ingredients.name: Fresh parsley, chopped
ingredients.notes: Garnish with fresh parsley for a pop of color

instructions: Preheat your grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together smoked paprika, garlic, mustard, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread lamb cubes and vegetables onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked to your liking.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
Serve with your favorite sides, such as German-style potato salad or braised red cabbage.
